title: Customer Review Insights with AI
summary: Thousands of product reviews tagged by topic and sentiment with AI, then turned into a dashboard of what to fix first.
result: 5,214 reviews tagged in minutes; delivery time surfaced as the top complaint.
note: Demo built with fictitious reviews. Low-confidence AI tags are flagged for a human check.

screenshots.alt: Sentiment by topic with AI-written summaries of the top complaint
Reviews sheet with AI-tagged topic, sentiment, summary and confidence

upworkBlurb: AI review analysis for an online store: a Python script sends each Amazon and Shopify review to an LLM, which tags the topic (delivery, quality, packaging, size, price, service, returns), the sentiment and a one-line summary. Results land in Google Sheets with a confidence score; low-confidence rows are flagged for a quick human check. A dashboard shows sentiment by topic and what customers complain about most. Demo uses fictitious reviews. Stack: Python, LLM API, Google Sheets, Power BI.
